exact_edition_year: ISO 14963:2003 (confirmed current status should be rechecked at order time)
scope_summary: Planning and classifying dynamic tests and investigations on bridges and viaducts.
overlap: FHWA and research guidance cover practical modal/dynamic tests; ISO adds a concise normative structure.
rationale: Purchase when dynamic testing becomes a specified acceptance or investigation activity. It is not required for the high-level architecture.
